meta.title: Network Engineer Assistant (network-command-kb)
meta.description: Three-in-one: a switch/router/firewall command knowledge base with 12 vendors and 96 documents (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS), a loadable network-command-kb skill, and the 网络工程师助手 agent preset.
